title: A THIRD GRENADE KIND RIDES IN THE BACKPACK
why: His order of 2026-10-13: grenades their own class of item with 2 slots. Build 4 of 8. The two throwable keys hold two kinds of grenade; a third kind has no key, so it is now carried in the backpack as items (weight 1 each) instead of in a pouch nobody could see. It shows in the grid, can be dropped, and can be dragged onto a throwable key, which swaps it in and moves the kind it pushed out into the backpack. How many he has of a kind is the pouch plus the backpack, a throw takes from the pouch first and then the backpack, a found grenade says BACKPACK on its pickup row when it has no key, and once a frame a kind with no key moves from the pouch to the backpack. The bot, the Undercroft belt and the arcade keep everything in the pouch as before.
now: A third kind of grenade is now carried in the backpack as items, and a throwable key swaps it in.
